text:
QUOTE: "The index was built with `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` passed as flags" and "`ssl_pthread_server.c:24-27` refuses to build unless both THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD are defined."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the macros gating the mutex and threading code, and says the mutexes are compiled out when they are off.
